name: The Fruit Game
detailed_description:
A fruit-merging puzzle game with adorable pets, collectible cosmetics, and dangerously satisfying combos.

The Fruit Game takes the viral merge concept and cranks it up with evolving pets, shop unlockables, and strategic boosts. Drop fruits into a container, combine matching ones into bigger fruits, and aim for the highest score before your fruity tower spills over.

Features

  • Addictive Core Gameplay – Drop and merge fruits to rack up points. The bigger the fruit, the bigger the score.

  • Charming Pet Companions – Hatch and raise unique animal friends like fruit bats, toucans, and squirrel monkeys. Keep them happy, clean, and fed!

  • Gameplay-Altering Powers – Pets help you in-game: remove fruits, trigger explosions, choose your next fruit, or save you from losing.

  • Cosmetics & Customization – Earn coins to unlock fruit skins, UI themes, and pet accessories. Express yourself through vibrant visuals.

  • Casual Yet Deep – Simple mechanics with a surprising amount of depth. Perfect for short sessions or long score-chasing marathons.

Your pets aren’t just for show. Each one comes with a unique ability based on its species and rarity:

  • Fruit Bats let you influence the next fruit drop.

  • Toucans cause fruit-clearing explosions.

  • Squirrel Monkeys remove unwanted fruits from the board.

  • Maned Wolves give you precious extra seconds when you’re about to lose.

Pets grow over time, respond to how you treat them, and eventually evolve—or, if neglected, pass away. With only four pet slots, you'll need to choose and care wisely.

There's no permanent power progression—just skill improvement, visual unlocks, and a growing bond with your pets. The shop is filled with fun cosmetics, and while some items are tied to achievements, most are available whenever you’ve earned enough coins.

short_description: A casual cute game about merging fruits and getting the highest score! You can also care and level up pets and in return they'll power up your runs! You can buy fruit skins, music, and backgrounds to customize your experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer (X64)
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
